- **A TT-30 outlet doesn't mean 30 amps of usable power.** A 2,400W inverter provides approximately 20A at 120V, so don't expect to run your rooftop air conditioner and multiple appliances simultaneously.

- **Expect less than 2kWh of usable AC energy.** After inverter losses, a practical planning estimate is around 1.7–1.9kWh.

A 2kWh power station isn't equivalent to a full 30A RV hookup.

- It can run typical essentials like an RV refrigerator, lights, water pump and coffee maker, subject to combined load.
- Don't expect it to run a rooftop air conditioner reliably.
- A two-way refrigerator should generally be switched to propane when off-grid; electric operation can consume more than the entire battery in a day.
